question: Does the s059k pipeline (surrogate-score grid -> cluster -> full-LC LM polish with multi-mag-start, no oracle injection) still deliver Band A solutions on post-fix seed 89, and what is the yield?
hypothesis: The s059j->s059k_full_lc architecture still produces Band A hi-fi solutions on regenerated post-fix data; specific seed-89 numerics may shift.
narrative_md: Re-ran the blind s059j+s059k_full_lc pipeline on post-fix seed 89. Architecture still produces a Band A hi-fi solution without oracle injection, but yield shifted 4/50 -> 1/50 unique Band A clusters. The single survivor (cluster_457, q0_err 59.58 deg, rho_hifi 0.904) is a multi-solution attractor, not the truth basin; truth ranks 1987/2013 and falls outside the top-50 polish window. Methodology survives; seed-89 numerics did not.
